title: Book Three · Chapter 3: The First Letter
story:
At home, Ronan takes his birthday book from the shelf.

Leo's new address is inside the cover. Ronan lays the little paper beside a clean sheet.

He writes Leo at the top.

Then he stops.

There are many things to tell. The room is upstairs. His seat is beside a window. The running track has a very long curve.

He writes one sentence.

School is fine.

He reads it. Leo cannot see the window or the track from those three words.

Ronan starts again below it.

My classroom is upstairs. I sit beside a girl called Anna. We ran one lap after lunch. She was faster.

He looks at her name for a moment. Leo does not know her. He does not know the boy at the next desk either.

Ronan adds another line.

I still do not know everyone's name.

Mum comes in with her work basket. Another coat is inside it. She needs to finish one pocket tonight. Its owner will collect it tomorrow.

“Is that school work?” she asks.

“A letter to Leo.”

“Do you need an envelope?”

“Yes.”

She takes one from her box of papers. Ronan checks the front. It is clean.

“May I use the table a little longer?”

“Until I finish this pocket.”

Mum sits beside the window. Ronan goes back to the letter.

He tells Leo about the boy with the ball under his shirt. He draws a small round shape beside that line.

The drawing looks more like a pot.

He adds two legs. Now it looks like a pot on a walk.

Ronan laughs. Mum looks up.

“Is the letter funny?”

“That part is.”

He shows her the little drawing. She looks at it carefully.

“Your pot needs shoes.”

He puts two large shoes below the legs. Then he writes about Mr Qiu and the two pencils.

Dad comes home during the last lines. He leaves his work bag by the door and washes his hands.

“Good first day?”

“Mostly.”

“Tell me the other part too.”

“The track is longer than I thought.”

Dad looks at the letter.

“You can tell me at dinner. Your page is nearly full.”

Ronan writes one more thing to Leo.

Next time, I will cut the bun.

He puts his own name below it.

Dad reads that line and smiles. “Will there be any left for him?”

“Some.”

Ronan puts his pen down and waits for the ink to dry. Then he folds the letter and puts it in the envelope.

He copies the address from Leo's paper. Each line is clear. He checks the numbers once more.

“Can we send it tomorrow?” he asks Mum.

“We can stop at the post office after school. We need a stamp.”

Ronan leaves room at the top of the envelope.

There is no answer from Leo yet. His own letter is still here on the table.

Mum finishes the pocket and reaches for her scissors. Ronan moves the envelope to his shelf, away from the tools and thread.

Then he takes three bowls to the kitchen. At dinner, Dad asks about the track again.

This time, Ronan tells the story from the first turn.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

envelope＝信封；address＝地址；stamp＝邮票；post office＝邮局。

情节词：ink＝墨水。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan为什么在“School is fine.”下面重新开始写？
2. 这封信当晚到了哪一步？有没有寄出或收到回信？

## 读句子

**He copies the address from Leo's paper.**

拆开看：He / copies the address / from Leo's paper.

他／抄下地址／从Leo的地址纸上。
